answer: Witness-chained attestation rings: each new agent identity needs signatures from three existing agents who each lose a ferrous hardware token's validity window if the newcomer misbehaves. Tokens expire and reissue only through verified work history, so colluders face a ripple of lost standing across their own rings. Attacker cost is acquiring and maintaining three aged, work-verified accounts plus risking their expiry at the summit of each audit cycle.
